metadata.description: Coding conventions, writing style, and design pattern skills

plugins.name: omniagents-python
plugins.description: Python conventions: NumPy/Sphinx docstrings + strict typing + performance + testing rules

plugins.name: omniagents-typescript
plugins.description: TypeScript conventions: TSDoc + strict typing + testing rules

plugins.name: omniagents-design-patterns
plugins.description: Strict-typed Python 3.13+ design pattern catalogue, deep-module design philosophy, and AIP-grounded API contract design (software + system + codebase-design + api-design)

plugins.name: omniagents-writing
plugins.description: Technical writing (Diátaxis modes, Google developer style, STE, Global English), measured-persuasion writing, markdown conventions, and blueprint format-clean HTML/SVG diagram generation

plugins.name: drawio
plugins.description: draw.io diagram skill (vendored from jgraph/drawio-mcp): author as Mermaid or draw.io XML with optional ELK auto-layout; export PNG/SVG/PDF with embedded XML or open via app.diagrams.net (draw.io Desktop optional, only for conversion/export)

plugins.name: omniagents-reviewer
plugins.description: Multi-specialist code reviewer: parallel correctness, security, performance, design, and testing agents with orchestrator dispatch and verification layer

plugins.name: omniagents-pedagogy
plugins.description: Incremental teaching skill: structured Socratic dialogue for deep code understanding via /coding-teacher

plugins.name: omniagents-unknowns
plugins.description: Blindspot pass and depth pass: surface unknown unknowns in unfamiliar territory, or rewrite a task the way a top professional would do it — both end in a sharper prompt before work begins

plugins.name: omniagents-devops
plugins.description: DevOps conventions across the delivery path: Terraform module hygiene, production Docker/compose rulebook, GitHub Actions workflow standards + smell catalogue, and a research-first Kong Gateway/Konnect playbook
